svg.title: Illustrated map of Casa Kayam in Guatape
svg.desc: Watercolor-style illustrated map showing Casa Kayam Art Hostel and Recording Studio outside Guatape, Colombia. The map places Casa Kayam east of Guatape village beside the Penol-Guatape reservoir, with a dotted walking route from the village to Casa Kayam marked as about 20 minutes. It includes key local landmarks such as La Piedra del Penol, Malecon de Guatape, Parque Principal de Guatape, Guatape Guia, Balcones de La Casona, Hotel Estaciones, El Mirador de Guatape, Ermita El Cristalino, Home and Peace El Cristalino, Eco Hostel Medellin, Hotel La Madriguera Guatape, El Nido Hotel Guatape, Rincon de Guatape, and Pecera Fantasia Restaurante. The legend identifies panoramic points, places of interest, accommodation, restaurants, churches, and boat rides.
